facts: Parties: Kestrel Software Ltd (Buyer), Merrion Logistics plc (Seller); the Company is Glenrock Technologies Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 29 January 2026; Closing is scheduled for 22 May 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.5 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 15% of the Purchase Price, being $18,000,000. The Purchase Price is $150,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Dunmore Retail Group plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Thornbury Capital LLP threatening proceedings for approximately $450,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
